issuer.description: the body that issues it, as it names itself

kind.description: what sort of document it is

version.description: version or edition as the issuer names it, when it has one

published.description: publication date the issuer gives, when stated

status.description: status as the issuer states it, when stated

url.description: the issuer's own page for it

applies_to.description: one sentence: what or whom it applies to
